name: PCQM4Mv2
description: A large-scale quantum chemistry benchmark containing approximately 3.7 million molecular graphs with 3D structures and HOMO-LUMO gap targets. This record describes the dataset and does not distribute data.
citation: Hu, W., Fey, M., Ren, H., Nakata, M., Dong, Y., sato, M., Kitagawa, M., & Leskovec, J. (2021). OGB-LSC: A Large-Scale Challenge for Machine Learning on Graphs. Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems, 34. https://arxiv.org/abs/2103.09430
